recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. Revisit only when the later FHIR-55255 THO migration is applied, at which point terminology ownership/location may change but the DeviceDefinition relationship meanings should be preserved.
issue_request: FHIR-36830 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested the DeviceDefinition.link.relation value set use gateway, replaces, and previous, remove obsolete container/connected-style codes, update definitions, and clarify the linked-device element as a linked device definition.
initial_application: Historical commits 39e7d269b9 and 5a10cc173a partially applied the issue by removing obsolete relation codes, but left DeviceDefinition relation definitions stale, kept CodeSystem.valueSet pointing at the Device value set, retained a placeholder ValueSet description, and left StructureDefinition prose saying device rather than device definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows DeviceDefinition is active and OO-owned. FHIR-36828 removed Device.link in favor of Device.gateway, so the current active binding needing correction is DeviceDefinition.link.relation. Later FHIR-39389 source work and applied FHIR-41597 retain DeviceDefinition.link.relatedDevice[x] as a canonical-or-code choice, so the older rename request is superseded by current R6 modeling while its device-definition wording remains applicable. FHIR-55255 may later move this terminology to THO but is not yet applied.
reconciliation: Updated source/devicedefinition/codesystem-devicedefinition-relationtype.xml, source/devicedefinition/valueset-devicedefinition-relationtype.xml, and source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml to align descriptions, value-set linkage, code definitions, and link element prose with DeviceDefinition relationship semantics while preserving relatedDevice[x].
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/codesystem-devicedefinition-relationtype.xml: corrected the description, CodeSystem.valueSet canonical, and gateway/replaces/previous definitions for DeviceDefinition relationships.
source/devicedefinition/valueset-devicedefinition-relationtype.xml: replaced the placeholder description with a DeviceDefinition relation description.

source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: clarified DeviceDefinition.link, link.relation, and link.relatedDevice[x] prose to refer to device definitions while keeping the later relatedDevice[x] choice name.
